history.name: A first edition is a plain inventory
history.description: The first release has nothing before it to be compared against, so its edition prints with nothing marked as new or changed anywhere. That is exactly right for a baseline of a product that already existed — it reads as a catalogue of what there is, not as a claim about what was just built.
history.dev_notes: buildRows() clears every badge when there's no predecessor; the front-page callout and the since-last-edition tallies are omitted too.
